### If this touches location, PII, or camera data

- [ ] Consistent with [`docs/adr/0004`](https://github.com/TechLuddite/kitty-come-home/blob/main/docs/adr/0004-privacy-and-location-handling.md)

- [ ] No sighting reporter contact details exposed outside the case team
- [ ] No camera footage uploaded by default

### Checklist

- [ ] Scope is consistent with [`docs/adr/`](https://github.com/TechLuddite/kitty-come-home/tree/main/docs/adr), or an issue argues for changing it
